title: Back in Black
listen_for: The drums are not machine-perfect – tiny rush/drag in the groove.
Faint room noise and cymbal decay between hits.
tip: Slight rushing and dragging of the drums instead of a metronome-perfect loop.

title: Enter Sandman (AI clone)
listen_for: Every vocal phrase lands the same way with almost no breathing in between.
Palm-muted guitars hit the grid with identical attack each time.
tip: Overly clean, perfectly repeated phrases with almost no breath noise.

title: Stairway to Heaven
listen_for: Acoustic guitar pick noise that changes from note to note.
The tempo gently pushes and relaxes as the song builds.
tip: Small changes in pick attack and tempo as the part gets louder.

title: Highway to Hell (AI)
listen_for: Rasp that sounds the same on every chorus line.
High notes never quite sound strained or tired.
tip: A cloned voice that keeps the same rasp and power all the way through.

title: Bohemian Rhapsody (AI)
listen_for: Choir harmonies that sound like one voice copied many times.
Very little wobble or timing drift between harmony parts.
tip: Stacked parts that feel like carbon copies instead of a messy group of singers.

title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
listen_for: Screamed lines that change rasp and loudness from phrase to phrase.
Guitars and drums that get slightly wilder instead of looping perfectly.
tip: Uneven rasp and intensity that a clone would usually smooth out.
